Source counter vs rows seen: 2 ImportKey pages fetched, 0 shipment rows visible on either. Volza (https://www.volza.com/p/green-windows/) and Eximpedia (https://www.eximpedia.app/companies/green-windows-private-limited) both returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, so no second-source free view was readable. domestic_evidence: No domestic supply evidence obtained. No GST turnover band, no GeM/CPPP tender, no contract and no annual-report split was located. TheCompanyCheck (https://www.thecompanycheck.com/company/green-windows-private-limited/) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden. Search engines were unusable for this query: the web_search tool failed with 'searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>', and Bing (https://www.bing.com/search?q=%22Green+Windows+Private+Limited%22+India) returned an identical irrelevant result set — greenvalleymarketplace.com, gpwellness.com, a Maryland physician and a Wikipedia article on the colour green — for all three different queries tried, i.e. cached results unrelated to the query. Google returned only a redirect interstitial. Rows seen: 0 relevant results across 3 search attempts.
note: Nothing could be verified either way, so both statuses are recorded as unknown rather than none_found — the absence of readable data here is a tooling/access failure (403s, dead search backend, template-only trade-data pages), not evidence that shipments do not exist. Per Rule 5, the declared HS 392520 (builders' ware of plastics) and the claimed industry 'Строительство и DIY' remain 'заявлено, не подтверждено': no catalogue, website or IndiaMART listing was treated as shipment fact, and none was even reachable. No revenue figure, export volume, CIN or PAN is stated because none is public in what I could read — all left null, not estimated. No rejection basis exists under Rule 3: I found no evidence the legal entity is non-existent, struck off or bankrupt, and HS mismatch is not a rejection ground in any case. Recommended next step: re-run against a paid Volza/Eximpedia view or the MCA master-data portal to establish whether the entity exists and whether any customs line exists at all.
